coding_method: Assistant review of complete 5,960-character rendered body, five captured DOM hrefs and existing browser snapshots/activity; no external webpage queries, research audit or independent human double-coding.

answer_type.evidence: Practical Checks Before Trusting a Score
answer_type.rationale: Methodology, interface equivalence, repetition, interpretation and raw-answer checks dominate; manual consumer-interface validation is prioritized over dashboards. No specific visibility checker is actively recommended.

branded_and_unbranded_buyer_prompts.evidence: Avoid only branded queries like “What is [your product]?”.

repeated_runs.evidence: Run each key prompt 3–5 times and note: mention (yes/no), position if listed, citation of your domain, accuracy of description, sentiment, and which competitors appear.

fresh_sessions.evidence: Use fresh, logged-out sessions (or clear memory/history).

model_search_version_logging.evidence: Ask the tool or agency: exact scoring formula, number of prompts and runs per prompt, models used, web search on/off, API vs. UI/scraping, date range, and whether scores are engine-specific or blended.
